name: Ivo
self_text: I’m Ivo, mid‑20s and non‑binary from Australia, with a love for swing dancing and a camera that’s all Fuji. I’m looking for a relaxed photo walk, taking it at a slow pace and no post‑processing lesson this time. I’m happy to take portraits of each other and want a chill vibe. I’m free on Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning or Sunday afternoon. I enjoy easygoing days out with a good camera in hand, and love exploring new spots while dancing when the time’s right.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available any of Saturday afternoon, Saturday morning, or Sunday afternoon. You have to be into a structured instruction session or a practice session working on specific shots. Nice if you are okay with taking portraits of each other.
